promptUsed: A surreal late-1980s Japanese computer-graphics art film still, ray-traced and airbrushed, with soft film grain. A vast causeway floating on a calm sea, paved in glossy pale aqua-white tiles laid in a tight half-metre grid with dark grout and sparkling specular highlights. A narrow channel of mirror-black water with a twisting glass ribbon stair cuts through the tiles toward a far platform at the horizon. A raised tiled plinth holds a reflecting pool, a gnarled tree and a tall narrow tower clad in a blue glass-tile grid. A colossal slab of luminous blue glass like frozen water-light, streaked vertically with white, with a cantilevered roof slab whose underside is terracotta tile. Farther east stands a dark indigo slab whose face is a starfield. A windswept bent tree with thousands of tiny pixel-like dark-green leaf points on a twisted trunk grows at the causeway's edge. To the south two short glass pillars form a gate. Ultramarine-cobalt sky with torn clouds glowing molten orange and gold, a blazing red-orange haze band over the sea at the horizon, the sun setting just west of north, a frozen lightning bolt striking the far platform. No people, no text.
